phase_name: One Shared Unicode-Aware Identifier Definition, Consumed by All Four Sites

objectives.description: Re-derive four identifier-class site locations by pattern
Define and export the shared identifier pattern once
Replace the identifier class at all four sites
Assert no ASCII-only identifier literal survives
Add failing-first test case R9 (non-ASCII name)
Add failing-first test case R10 (truncation-collision guard)
Confirm sort consistency for non-ASCII name
Demonstrate R9/R10 fail before, pass after

notes: All edits landed in the source store (~/.config/nvim); files_touched intentionally empty here per the same cross-repo rationale as Phase 1. Shared pattern: export LEAN_IDENT_PATTERN="[^\W\d][\w']*", read via os.environ in each of the 4 quoted python3 heredocs. Suite rose from 17 to 19 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped. R9/R10 confirmed red against the Phase-1 commit (sha 80d43b2e2) and green after this phase's edits. Source-store commit sha 330a9309c. The two foreign uncommitted files observed in Phase 1 (ladder-counter-observables.md, index-entries.json) remain untouched and unstaged.
